svg.text: Offline Edge AI Acoustic Threat Detection to GSM SMS Gateway
Remote National Park (No Internet — Dead Zone)
Figure 1: Alertreck System Architecture — Offline Park Edge AI to GSM Network
Alert Path: Threat sound → INMP441 (I2S) → VAD + Features → TFLite INT8 Inference → GPS Fix (AT+CGNSINF) → SMS (AT+CMGS) → GSM Network → Ranger
Admin Path: Detection event → Grad-CAM heatmap + SQLite log → Flask LAN Dashboard (port 5000) → Admin browser on local network
Constraint: End-to-end latency < 30 s · Zero internet at any stage · Sub-USD 80 hardware · USB power bank operation
